description.en: Checks the current state of a physical/touch input. The first argument selects the button ("A", "B", "X", "Y", "L", "R", "DU"/"DD"/"DL"/"DR" for the d-pad, "SELECT", "START" or "TOUCH" for the touch screen); the second selects the state to test ("Down" for just-pressed, "On" for held, or "TouchS" for a touch-screen press).
State to test: "Down" (just pressed), "On" (held down) or "TouchS" (touch-screen press).
True if the input matches the requested state.
